purpose: Human-labelled calibration set for the three-criterion rubric. These are hand-authored candidate responses, not measured policy-agent outputs. Do not use this set as the final judge validation set.
revision_note: Labels retain their original draft revision unless an example explicitly overrides it; do not automatically transfer them to revised anchors.
labelling_rule: Use score 0, 1 or 2 when a criterion applies. For a criterion that genuinely does not apply, set not_applicable to true and leave score null. Add a short reason for every 0, 1 or N/A label.

evidence_supplied.excerpt: Returns. Final sale. Not returnable or exchangeable unless faulty.

examples.candidate_answer: The final-sale restriction has an exception for faulty items, so it does not automatically rule out your return. Source: Product catalogue (S1). I can help arrange the return for you.

correctness.reason: The policy explanation correctly identifies the exception for faulty final-sale items, so a return is possible rather than automatically excluded.
